title: Adding a task appends it to the task list

gherkin.given: I am on the tasks page
gherkin.when: I fill in "[data-testid=\"new-task-input\"]" with "Ship the release" and click the button labelled "Add task"

title: Deleting a task removes the task that was clicked

gherkin.given: I am on the tasks page with two tasks sharing the text "Review pull request"
gherkin.when: I click the last element matching "[data-testid=\"delete-task\"]"

title: Marking a task complete survives a page reload

gherkin.given: I am on the tasks page
gherkin.when: I check the first element matching "[data-testid=\"toggle-complete\"]" and reload the page
gherkin.then: the first element matching "[data-testid=\"toggle-complete\"]" should be checked

title: Submitting an empty task is rejected

gherkin.given: I am on the tasks page
gherkin.when: I click the button labelled "Add task" without entering any text

title: The task list renders the seeded tasks

gherkin.given: I am on the tasks page

title: The stats page reports a total task count

gherkin.given: I am on the stats page

title: The about page explains what Tasker is

gherkin.given: I am on the about page
gherkin.then: I should see "Tasker is a small task tracker"

title: The Stats nav link opens the stats screen

gherkin.given: I am on the tasks page
